name: ur5
_dh_source: Universal Robots official Modified-DH parameters (UR5), see https://www.universal-robots.com/articles/ur/application-installation/dh-parameters-for-calculations-of-kinematics-and-dynamics/. Order: alpha_{i-1}, a_{i-1}, d_i, theta_i.
_joint_limits_note: Default UR5 spec is +/- 2*pi but paper experiments cap at +/- pi to disable rotational ambiguity; the IIWA14 Z4 cache assumption does not apply to UR robots, so experiments should set z4_enabled=false.
link_radii_comment: Conservative outer-bound capsule radii (m) per joint+tool slot. Length 7 = 6 joints + 1 tool slot. The active-link map skips the base and zero-length links; UR5 active links are the shoulder-to-wrist chain after the base/link1 protection zone.
